text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin, who loves running more<n>than anyone,
takes on the<n>international competition and wins the
Japan Cup in spectacular fashion.

The venue rumbles as the crowd<n>chants her name.
And she answers<n>their calls directly.

Her family, friends, fans—they all see<n>a dream in
her. And Ines is enjoying<n>that dream more than
anyone...
